segments.text: When you SSTORE on Amsterdam, what are you paying for — touching the slot, changing it, or creating it?
EIP-8038 splits the write into touch, change, and create. Amsterdam ships it.
Default: update a slot that already holds a value.
Touch two thousand one hundred. Change ten thousand. Create stays empty.
First write to an empty slot. Create is state gas — about ninety-seven thousand nine hundred twenty.
Amsterdam prices touch, change, and create apart. Run the same write on Osaka to see the smaller change.
Read EIP-8038 on eips.ethereum.org. Split the write on feelyourprotocol dot org.
